_comment: Every key is optional. Delete what you don't need -- an empty {} renders the defaults.
_report_title: Main heading. A --title argument overrides this. Default: 'Defect Pipeline'.
subtitle: Demo Corp · Demo · open demo_testing defects by position in the lifecycle
_eyebrow: Small label above the title. Default: 'Defect Lifecycle Tracker'.
_phase_of: Merged over the built-in map. Valid phases: Backlog, Analysis, Development, Customer Testing, Deferred.
_priority_thresholds: A tile highlights red when its count is strictly greater than this.
_priority_exclude_phases: Phases left out of the P1-P5 totals. Use [] to count every open item.
_as_of: ISO 8601. Defaults to the export's own generation timestamp, which is almost always what you want.
_footnote: Overrides the generated paragraph. HTML allowed. The source/caveat line underneath is always generated.
